io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.networks.energy

Class EnergyNet

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.network.Network
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.networks.energy.EnergyNet
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    HologramOwner, ItemAttribute

    public class EnergyNet
extends Network
implements HologramOwner
    The EnergyNet is an implementation of Network that deals with electrical energy being sent from and to nodes.

      • getRange

        public int getRange()
        Description copied from class: Network
        This method returns the range of the Network. The range determines how far the Network will search for nearby nodes from any given node. It basically translates to the maximum distance between nodes.
        Specified by:
        getRange in class Network
